about: World hashes after N game days (N x steps_per_day steps from a fresh world). The ONE shared fixture for determinism evidence: asserted natively and in wasm by crates/client-wasm/tests/runner_golden.rs, and under the Bun runner by packages/runner/test/golden.test.ts. When sim-core changes the world on purpose, regenerate with: for each case, bun packages/runner/src/cli.ts run --seed S --days N --world W --json (sim.final.hash), then run both tests.
